# Austrian Post subsidiary euShipments.com acquires Slovakian fulfillment provider FHB Group

By Alex Pack August 10, 2026 2 Mins Read

 The acquisition adds two fulfillment sites near Bratislava and expands euShipments.com's network to 27 countries, as Austrian Post Group grows its CEE/SEE logistics footprint 

euShipments.com, in which Austrian Post owns a 70% stake, has acquired 100% of Slovakian fulfillment provider FHB Group, effective August 10. The parties have agreed not to disclose the purchase price.

FHB Group will be fully integrated into the euShipments.com network, and the Slovakian company’s existing management team will remain in place following the acquisition. euShipments.com is already established in Slovakia through its subsidiary euShipments Slovakia, and the deal expands its position as a logistics partner for online retailers in the region.

“By acquiring the FHB Group, we are consistently expanding our position as one of Europe’s leading e-commerce and fulfillment providers,” said Peter Umundum, deputy CEO and board member

# Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte. · 2026-09-02T00:00:00+00:00

Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte.

Am 1. September eröffnet unser neuer Standort in Lotte. Damit liegt jetzt die Hälfte unseres gesamten FLEX. Lagernetzwerks in Deutschland.

OSN3 ergänzt WIL1 in Wilhelmshaven und MAG2 in Hermsdorf. Drei Standorte, die unterschiedliche Teile derselben Aufgabe abdecken: Ware näher an den richtigen Markt bringen, Übergaben sauber halten und Verkäufern mehr Spielraum geben, wenn sich Volumen oder Vertriebskanäle verändern.

Und Deutschland ist nur ein Teil des Bildes. FLEX. betreibt inzwischen sechs Lagerstandorte in Deutschland, Frankreich, Polen und Großbritannien.

Für uns ist OSN3 deshalb mehr als eine neue Adresse in Lotte. Es ist ein weiterer Baustein in einem Netzwerk, das europäische Fulfilment weniger fragmentiert machen soll.

Willkommen im Netzwerk, OSN3. ❤️

#FLEXlogistik #EcommerceLogistik #Lagerlogistik #CrossBorderLogistics

# GLS expands fulfilment offering with new centre in Denmark

GLS expands its fulfilment footprint with a new purpose-built centre in Kolding, marking the company's entry into fulfilment services in Denmark.

 07 October 2026 - 2 min 

- GLS Denmark has broken ground on a new fulfilment centre in Kolding, marking its entry into fulfilment services.
- The 5,000-square-metre facility is expected to be ready for use ahead of the 2027 peak season and can be scaled to 15,000 square metres to accommodate further growth.
- The investment supports GLS Group’s ambition to connect parcel delivery and fulfilment in a broader end-to-end offering for customers.

Amsterdam, 6 October 2026 – GLS is expanding its fulfilment capabilities with a new purpose-built centre in Kolding, Denmark.
